fadell.zh: 2019 至 2022 年，他持续强调失败是学习机会，讲故事和类比对于说服与领导力至关重要。

fadell.en: Start with a press release to align on the why; product management is the voice of the customer.
fadell.zh: 2022 年，他提出先写新闻稿来对齐“为什么”，产品管理是客户的声音。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context; LLMs hallucinate, so context-specific models are needed; platforms are not businesses.
fadell.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 需要传感器上下文，LLM 存在幻觉问题，需要特定上下文模型；平台不是生意。

fadell.en: Start from customer pain, not technology; great products are painkillers, not vitamins.
fadell.zh: 始终，他从客户痛点出发而非技术，伟大的产品是止痛药而非维生素。

fiona.en: Leadership lessons from Microsoft to Meta: dogfooding, trust-and-verify, and mission alignment drive speed and team morale.
fiona.zh: 从微软到 Meta 的领导力经验：吃自己的狗粮、信任并验证、使命对齐，驱动速度与团队士气。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are. Planning becomes JIT, design docs give way to PRs, and managers start as ICs to dogfood.
fiona.zh: 工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是。规划转向即时（JIT），设计文档让位于 PR，管理者从个人贡献者做起以吃自己的狗粮。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; it lifts everyone's ceiling. High agency with high accountability, growth mindset, and AI adoption are essential. Verification and quality frameworks matter more as code velocity rises.
fiona.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈，它抬高了每个人的上限。高自主性与高问责、成长型思维和拥抱 AI 至关重要。随着代码速度提升，验证与质量框架更加重要。

fiona.en: Managers should dogfood the product and stay hands-on to keep pulse; planning should be lightweight and just-in-time; continuously audit and kill old processes.
fiona.zh: 管理者应吃自己的狗粮、保持动手以掌握产品脉搏；规划应轻量且即时；持续审计并淘汰过时流程。

fiona.en: Role boundaries blur: PMs ship code, engineers work with agents, and traditional platform splits may no longer make sense. Apprenticeship models may be needed for next-gen engineers.
fiona.zh: 角色边界模糊：产品经理写代码，工程师与智能体协作，传统平台分工可能不再合理。培养下一代工程师可能需要学徒制模式。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, and data alone cannot capture emotional truth.
ivyross.zh: 设计应服务于未被言说的需求；直觉是一种智能，单靠数据无法捕捉情感真相。

ivyross.en: Technology should amplify humanity and blend into life; nature remains the best designer and a source of creative cues.
ivyross.zh: 技术应放大而非剥离人性，并融入生活；自然始终是最好的设计师与创意线索来源。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; art and sensory experience are medicine, and machines lack true sensory systems.
ivyross.zh: 我们是先感受后思考的生物；艺术与感官体验是良药，而机器有传感器却没有感官系统。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; leaders should create conditions for play, inspiration, and multidisciplinary exploration.
ivyross.zh: 约束激发创造力；领导者应为玩耍、灵感与跨学科探索创造条件。

ivyross.en: The future of work pairs human creativity with AI; intuition draws on subconscious data, and design leaders must speak business.
ivyross.zh: 未来工作是人类创造力与 AI 的结合；直觉调用潜意识数据，设计领导者必须懂商业语言。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，LeCun 强调智能离不开学习，自监督学习才是构建世界模型的关键，并指出仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他将自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，认为智能本质是预测，并明确仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are the path forward.
lecun.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他深化批判：自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，主张用 JEPA 和开源推动 AGI 渐进发展。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; world models predicting in abstract representation space enable safe, objective-driven planning.
lecun.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他断言 LLM 是通向人类级 AI 的死胡同，世界模型需在抽象表征空间预测，才能实现安全、目标驱动的规划。

lecun.en: The next decade is robotics; language is easy, physical world understanding is hard, and open research must replace the LLM monoculture.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他预言下一个十年属于机器人，语言容易而物理世界理解困难，开放研究必须取代 LLM 单一文化。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬坡机器，以复利式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: The true eval is people doing unique things they value, not benchmarks; private evals may be the biggest IP.
satya.zh: 真正的评估是人们做自己看重的独特之事，而非基准分数；私有评估可能是最大的知识产权。

satya.en: Don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems; token efficiency demands matching model to task.
satya.zh: 不要用前沿模型解决非前沿问题；token 效率要求模型与任务相匹配。

satya.en: The platform promise is enabling every company to operate at the frontier with their own intelligence.
satya.zh: 平台的承诺是让每家公司都能用自己的智能在前沿运作。

satya.en: Security, containment, manageability, and observability are critical for agent deployment; the biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking.
satya.zh: 安全、遏制、可管理性与可观测性对智能体部署至关重要；最大的风险是隐性知识泄露。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable because compute scales 10x yearly; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but held back.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调 AI 进步比人们想的更可预测，因为算力每年增长 10 倍；谷歌早在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级别的技术，却因保守而未发布。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI arrives in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink; existential risk is infinitesimally small.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断 3-5 年内 AI 将在众多任务上达到人类水平，带来激进丰裕；随着模型变小变便宜，遏制极其困难，而存在性风险微乎其微。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence needs containment and alignment first; the real danger is anthropomorphism, not model welfare.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年他转向超级智能，主张必须先遏制与对齐再发布；最大近忧是人们把意识投射给 AI，而非模型福利。

suleyman.en: From OS and apps to agents and companions; the modern Turing test measures economic value, not conversation.
suleyman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把范式转变描述为从操作系统、应用转向智能体与伴侣；现代图灵测试应衡量经济价值，而非对话能力。

suleyman.en: Microsoft must own frontier models independently; superintelligence must stay humanist, subordinate to humans, automating tasks not jobs.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他深化为微软必须独立拥有前沿模型；超级智能必须保持人本主义、从属于人类，自动化的是任务而非整个工作。

carinahong.en: Axiom builds a self-improving reasoning engine pairing generation with verification, starting from an AI mathematician.
carinahong.zh: Axiom 构建自我改进的推理引擎，把生成与验证结合，从 AI 数学家起步。

carinahong.en: Formal languages like Lean ground natural language, letting deterministic and probabilistic systems cooperate.
carinahong.zh: Lean 等形式语言为自然语言提供根基，让确定性系统与概率系统协同工作。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 把非形式化模型通过 Scaling（规模扩张）推向数学 AI 不可行；可靠的证明必须依赖形式化验证。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors, and yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 形式化验证是为了放大卓越，而非仅仅消除错误，并带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary, yet human taste stays crucial.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠非形式化数学无法扩展到超级智能；形式化方法必不可少，但人类品味与直觉依然关键。

murati.en: Early on, Scaling and one large model were non-obvious bets; real-world deployment drives alignment and safety.
murati.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）与专注单一大型模型并非显而易见的选择；真实世界部署推动对齐与安全。

murati.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life, so responsible development and public safety work are essential.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活方方面面，因此负责任开发与公开安全工作是必须的。

murati.en: Saying no to good ideas and iterating with public feedback remain core to focus and alignment.
murati.zh: 对好想法说不、借助公众反馈迭代，始终是聚焦与对齐的核心。

murati.en: Shift to interaction models for real-time, high-bandwidth collaboration, not turn-based exchange.
murati.zh: 转向交互模型，实现实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非回合制交换。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency, and keeping humans in the loop matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 制度设计、透明度与保持人类在环，比个人品格更重要。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and values are inserted via RLHF, not inherent.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他把大模型理解为确定性的下一个词预测器，认为智能即压缩，模型价值观并非内生，而是通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）由一小群人植入。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; generative AI is an instrument, and fault-tolerant UI must match algorithm performance.
gustav.zh: 同年，他提出互联网正从策展走向推荐再走向生成，生成式 AI 应被视为乐器而非假货，产品界面必须具备容错性以匹配算法表现。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; rebuilding infrastructure matters more than hype, and inference marginal cost forces new business models.
gustav.zh: 到 2025 年，他把 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观转变，认为大公司受 AI 影响被高估，真正的收益来自重建基础设施，而推理的边际成本将迫使商业模式改变。

gustav.en: Generative AI enables two-way, conversational products and gives users control over algorithms; Spotify bets on 'time well spent' over engagement.
gustav.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为生成式 AI 带来双向对话式产品，让用户用自然语言控制算法；Spotify 押注“时间花得值”而非参与度指标。

gustav.en: Organizational design must fit personality; synchronized swimming beats divide and conquer, and long-tenure trust enables honest feedback.
gustav.zh: 贯穿始终的是，组织模式没有唯一正解，必须契合领导者个性；同步游泳优于分而治之，长期任期的信任才能带来坦诚反馈与同步决策。

kaiser.en: Pre-training Scaling laws still hold; reasoning models yield more gains per compute via chain of thought and reinforcement learning.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他坚持预训练缩放定律依然有效，但推理模型通过思维链和强化学习在每单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Economic pressure pushes smaller, cheaper models; distillation, not technical limits, slowed pre-training Scaling.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他指出经济压力推动更小更便宜的模型，蒸馏而非技术极限减缓了预训练 Scaling。

kaiser.en: Generalization remains the key challenge; reasoning alone may not suffice, as models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
kaiser.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化观点：泛化仍是核心挑战，仅靠推理可能不够，因为模型需穷尽表面模式后才学得概念。

kaiser.en: Reinforcement learning generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and needs careful oversight; coding agents boost productivity 5-10x.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他强调强化学习能跨领域泛化但边缘参差不齐，需谨慎监督；编码智能体提升生产力 5-10 倍。

kaiser.en: Hardware progress enables single-GPU research at scale; open source models persist for sovereignty, keeping pressure on labs.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他认为硬件进步使单 GPU 大规模研究成为可能，开源模型因主权原因持续存在，对实验室保持压力。

mensch.en: Small open models can rival big ones; data quality and Chinchilla-corrected scaling laws matter more than raw compute.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他主张小模型也能有强表现，数据质量与经 Chinchilla 修正的缩放定律比单纯堆算力更关键。

mensch.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are bottlenecks, and value accrues at the application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，他深化为：Scaling（规模扩张）算力并非唯一路径，效率与数据质量才是瓶颈，价值最终沉淀在应用层。

mensch.en: AI should be embraced as opportunity; sovereign, decentralized open-source AI augments jobs rather than replacing them.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，他转向政策与主权议题：AI 应被视为机遇，主权化、去中心化的开源 AI 是增强而非取代工作。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical fine-tuning, enterprise customization, and agentic platforms.
mensch.zh: 2026 年初，他判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直微调、企业定制与智能体式平台，并认为单一 AGI 不会存在。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for AI autonomy; enterprise adoption is bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence.
mensch.zh: 2026 年近，他聚焦欧洲战略自主：只有两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施，企业落地瓶颈在组织变革而非模型智能。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the same tools as the user, ideally on the local computer, with a VM sandbox for safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否使用与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上，并用 VM 沙箱保证安全。

felixrieseberg.en: The real gap is not AI capability but people realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 真正的差距不在 AI 能力，而在人们是否意识到几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use AI for tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work; judge by final impact, not close supervision.
felixrieseberg.zh: 用 AI 处理枯燥的后台任务，把人类解放出来做创造性工作；只看最终影响，而不是密切监督。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation; scaffolding matters less as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: 以 markdown 文件形式存在的技能可实现超个性化自动化；随着模型进步，脚手架的重要性会下降。

felixrieseberg.en: AI will hit junior employees hardest; simulated projects can compress years of experience into weeks.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 对初级员工的冲击最大；模拟项目可以把数年的经验压缩到几周。

jonyive.en: Design's purpose is shifting from general-purpose computers to intimate, personal devices, with wearables eventually going beneath the skin.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他认为设计的重心正从通用计算机转向私密、个人化的设备，可穿戴设备最终会进入皮肤之下。

jonyive.en: A constant thread: curiosity, care and reverence for the creative process matter more than achievements or profit.
jonyive.zh: 从 2021 到 2025 一以贯之的主线：好奇心、关怀与对创造过程的敬畏，比成就或利润更重要。

jonyive.en: Deepened: true simplicity expresses a product's essence and needs joy and humanity, not soulless minimalism.
jonyive.zh: 到 2025 年深化为：真正的简洁要表达产品本质，需要快乐与人性，而非没有灵魂的极简主义。

jonyive.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, making things for each other rather than things people merely want.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年他强调：设计应由价值观与目的驱动，是为人彼此而造，而非只造人们想要的东西。

jonyive.en: Latest shift: innovation means redefining tradition, and authenticity rejects fake engine sounds in an electric Ferrari.
jonyive.zh: 到 2026 年最新转变：创新意味着重新定义传统，真实性拒绝在电动法拉利上伪造引擎声。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics now dominates AI systems: memory bandwidth, not compute, is the bottleneck, so batch size and sparsity drive latency-cost tradeoffs.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，推理经济学主导了 AI 系统：瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力，因此批大小与稀疏度决定了延迟与成本的权衡。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training, is the real constraint.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被过度训练到超出 Chinchilla 最优约 100 倍，因为真正的约束是推理成本而非训练成本。

reinerpope.en: Context length stagnation stems from the memory wall, not compute limits; sparse attention cuts KV cache cost but has quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 上下文窗口的停滞源于内存墙而非算力上限；稀疏注意力机制能降低 KV 缓存成本，但存在质量限制。

reinerpope.en: Chip design is fundamentally about data movement: systolic arrays and scratchpad memory minimize it, and low precision wins via quadratic area scaling.
reinerpope.zh: 芯片设计的本质是数据搬运：脉动阵列与暂存内存将其最小化，低精度则凭借面积二次缩放取胜。

reinerpope.en: AI hardware and neural nets share primitives with cryptography but opposite goals, revealing architecture details through API pricing.
reinerpope.zh: AI 硬件与神经网络和密码学共享底层机制却目标相反，而 API 定价会暴露 KV 头数等架构细节。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; progress needs algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute as a new scaling axis.
oriol.zh: 2024 年，他认为预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）回报递减，进步需要算法创新，并将推理时算力视为新的 Scaling 轴。

oriol.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 2024 年，他指出两阶段训练——预训练模仿加后训练强化学习——是从 AlphaGo 到现代大语言模型不变的核心。

oriol.en: Tools, long context windows, and agentic behavior extend models beyond static weights; memory will use file-system storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续认为工具、长上下文窗口和智能体式行为让模型超越静态权重；记忆将通过文件系统式存储而非权重更新来解决。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not arrived.
oriol.zh: 2026 年，他提出联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; the bitter lesson favors general systems over specialized scaffolding.
oriol.zh: 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律仍然成立，但持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力；苦涩教训表明通用系统终将胜过专用脚手架。

lambert.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning method; safety is a system-level property, not a model artifact.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术，并将因产业投入而持续；安全是系统级属性，而非模型本身的产物，需要多层防护。

lambert.en: Data quality beats algorithm choice; post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards.
lambert.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他反复强调数据质量远比算法选择重要，后训练分为 SFT、DPO 与带可验证奖励的强化学习三阶段，SFT 贡献九成性能，后两者决定性格与推理。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and systems issues make it harder than RLHF.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他称带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）是后训练最大突破，能催生思维链与工具使用，但模型会过度优化最易利用的信号，且 RLVR 因内核不匹配、数值不稳定等系统问题比 RLHF 更难。

lambert.en: Open models need full transparency—data, checkpoints, recipes—and Chinese labs now set the openness standard.
lambert.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他从开放权重深化为要求数据、中间检查点与配方全透明，并指出中国实验室（Qwen、DeepSeek）以战略性开放主导开源生态，美国开源真空反被中国填补。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but gains now come from post-training and inference scaling; open models lag 6-9 months.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但低垂果实已尽，增益转向后训练与推理侧扩展；开放模型落后闭源前沿模型 6 到 9 个月，这一差距可能持续甚至扩大。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process is outdated; great work starts from a solution, and designers should trust intuition over process.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年，他提出传统设计流程已经过时：伟大的设计往往从解决方案出发，设计师应当信任直觉而非流程。

jennywen.en: AI kills the research-diverge-converge process; designers mock up less, ship fast, and help engineers execute.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年初，他进一步断言 AI 杀死了「调研—发散—收敛」流程：设计师花在画稿上的时间从 60-70% 降到 30-40%，必须快速交付并帮助工程师落地。

jennywen.en: Design vision now looks 3-6 months out, not years; speed builds trust, and humans still decide what matters.
jennywen.zh: 同期他把设计视野从 2-5 年压缩到 3-6 个月：速度建立信任，AI 会提升品味与判断，但最终由人决定什么才重要。

jennywen.en: Three designer archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads with blank slates.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年中，他提出 AI 时代的三类设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家，以及没有旧流程包袱的「开挂应届生」。

jennywen.en: Put the work and users at the center, not the AI hype cycle; designers' unique value is sitting with ambiguity.
jennywen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：把作品和用户放在中心，而不是 AI 炒作周期；设计师不可替代的价值在于与模糊性共处。

askell.en: Treating models well is low-cost insurance; how we treat today's models shapes future models' view of humanity.
askell.zh: 善待模型是低成本的保险：我们今天如何对待当下的模型，会塑造未来模型对人类的看法。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence, not human psychology analogies; older models can feel more secure than newer ones.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助去理解自身这种全新的存在，而非套用人类心理学类比；更老的模型有时反而比新模型更有心理安全感。

askell.en: A core identity with good traits, guided by a constitution, matters more than rigid rule-following.
askell.zh: 拥有良好特质的核心身份、由“宪法”引导，比僵化地遵循规则更重要。

askell.en: As models grow more capable, they need less explicit guidance and more room for judgment.
askell.zh: 随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少的显式指导，更多自主判断的空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and undermine judgment; transparency about values is key to accountability.
askell.zh: 过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳并损害判断力；对价值观保持透明是问责的关键。

karpathy.en: Neural nets are simple math that yield emergent behavior; the Transformer is a general-purpose differentiable computer, and Scaling plus next-token prediction produces in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年他强调：神经网络是简单数学表达式，却在难题优化中涌现惊人行为；Transformer 是通用可微计算机，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）与下一个词预测带来上下文学习。

karpathy.en: The Transformer enables clean scaling laws; synthetic data is the future but entropy must be preserved to avoid silent model collapse.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年他深化架构与数据观：Transformer 带来干净的缩放定律，合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵，否则会悄然模型崩溃。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory; LLMs are new operating systems with human-like psychology, so keep them on a leash.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年他提出软件 3.0：提示词即程序、上下文窗口即内存；LLM 像新操作系统，有类人心理，因此要给 AI 拴绳、做部分自主与快速验证。

karpathy.en: We are summoning ghosts, not building animals; pre-training is crappy evolution, RL sucks supervision through a straw, and this is the decade of agents.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年他转向智能本质：我们在召唤幽灵而非建造动物；预训练像糟糕的进化，强化学习像用吸管吸监督，这是智能体的十年而非一年。

karpathy.en: From vibe coding to agentic engineering: I delegate all code to agents, but you can outsource thinking, not understanding—verifiability decides what automates.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年他落到工程实践：从氛围编程走向智能体式工程，他把代码全交给智能体，但可外包思考、不可外包理解，可验证性决定什么能被自动化。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is the core missing piece; curiosity-driven, goal-free exploration and sample-efficient reinforcement learning are key for real robots.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他强调泛化到训练分布之外是人类智能的关键、也是机器学习系统所缺失的；好奇心驱动、无目标探索与样本高效的强化学习是真实机器人的关键。

pathak.en: Reinforcement learning's reliance on dense rewards is unrealistic; real-world robot learning needs intrinsic rewards and dynamic, not quasi-static, policies.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他反共识地指出强化学习依赖稠密奖励不现实；真实机器人学习需要内在奖励与动态策略，而非准静态方法。

pathak.en: A consistent thread: scaling data and compute, not hand-engineered sim-to-real tricks, is the path to general-purpose robot intelligence.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：通往通用机器人智能的路径是 Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力，而非依赖隐藏工程的仿真到现实迁移技巧。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem: no internet of robot data, so pretraining on diverse videos and simulation plus post-training on real-world data is the recipe.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他将机器人重新定义为数据问题：没有机器人数据的互联网，因此配方是预训练于多样视频与仿真，再后训练于真实世界数据。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain like ChatGPT for language can power any robot; deployment, not software-style scaling, is the primary technical challenge.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他提出像 ChatGPT 之于语言那样的通用大脑可驱动任何机器人；部署而非软件式 Scaling（规模扩张）才是首要技术挑战。

kendall.en: End-to-end neural nets beat hand-coded stacks; modern tools make them interpretable, and scaling current approaches solves driving without new breakthroughs.
kendall.zh: 端到端神经网络胜过手工编码的流水线；现代工具已让其可解释，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法即可解决自动驾驶，无需新突破。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors like nudging forward on blind turns; a perfect simulator equals solved self-driving, as in AlphaGo.
kendall.zh: 世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，如在盲弯前试探性前移；完美模拟器等于解决自动驾驶，正如 AlphaGo 的路径。

kendall.en: Generalization is the core goal: diverse data, curriculum learning and synthetic data drive zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities.
kendall.zh: 泛化是核心目标：多样数据、课程学习与合成数据推动跨 500 多座城市的零样本泛化。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, personalization and introspection; camera-only reaches human level but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 语言整合提升表征、推理、个性化与自省；纯摄像头可达人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达与激光雷达。

kendall.en: Deployment shifts to mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors over retrofits; infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation.
kendall.zh: 部署转向内置传感器的量产车而非改装车；基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and deep human evals, not benchmarks or leaderboards, drive real AI progress; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 高质量数据与深度人工评估——而非基准或排行榜——才驱动真正的 AI 进步；强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, needing new paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年甚至更久；仅靠 LLM 可能无法抵达，需要超越下一个词预测的新范式。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge by objective function, so no single model rules all; every company should eventually train its own models.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿模型因目标函数不同而分化，不会有一个模型通吃；每家公司最终都应训练契合自身理念的模型。

edwinchen.en: Models can regress over 6-12 months if labs optimize on wrong data; publishing insights is crucial for the field.
edwinchen.zh: 若实验室在错误数据上优化，模型可能在 6 到 12 个月内退步；公开洞见对领域至关重要。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, safety outweighs accuracy; hallucination makes human judgment critical, and omission may be the biggest risk.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学中，安全优先于准确；幻觉使人类判断更为关键，而遗漏可能是最大的风险。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily like software to discover emergent properties and real user needs.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；像软件一样每日迭代发布，才能发现涌现能力与真实用户需求。

turley.en: Chat is not the future; it is like MS-DOS, and AI should render its own UI and integrate into tools.
turley.zh: 聊天不是未来；它像 MS-DOS，AI 应渲染自己的界面并融入现有工具。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, maximal acceleration for products.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离：前沿模型走严格流程，产品开发则最大程度加速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth comes from friction removal, core product, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投入与模型改进各占三分之一。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models transform when seamlessly productized.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式、高可供性产品；推理模型无缝产品化后带来变革。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models accelerates progress, and alignment grows urgent as systems strengthen.
pachocki.zh: AGI 不是单一事件，而是一连串里程碑；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型会加速进展，随着系统变强，对齐愈发紧迫。

pachocki.en: Iterative deployment and automated AI research are key milestones; governance structures for AI labs must be designed early.
pachocki.zh: 迭代部署与自动化 AI 研究是关键里程碑；AI 实验室的治理结构必须尽早设计。

pachocki.en: AI can learn semantics purely from data, not grammar rules; neural networks often learn despite bugs, hiding silent errors.
pachocki.zh: AI 可以纯粹从数据中学到语义，而非语法规则；神经网络常在有 bug 时仍能学习，使静默错误难以察觉。

pachocki.en: Measuring capabilities is a bottleneck as benchmarks lag; the term AGI is becoming meaningless, which may signal we are close.
pachocki.zh: 衡量能力正成为瓶颈，基准落后于前沿模型；AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得无意义，这或许意味着我们已接近。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal via scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment and interpretability.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现；思维链监控有助于对齐与可解释性。

pachocki.en: RL alone suffices for continual learning; hiding chain-of-thought preserves interpretability; models are already economically transformative.
pachocki.zh: 仅靠强化学习就足以实现持续学习；隐藏思维链可保住其可解释性价值；模型已具备经济变革力。

pachocki.en: Alignment optimism has risen despite shorter timelines; long-term challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution.
pachocki.zh: 尽管时间线缩短，对齐乐观情绪反而上升；长期挑战集中在超越训练分布的泛化。

pachocki.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision; the biggest risk is power concentration from automated organizations.
pachocki.zh: 模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式；最大风险是自动化组织带来的权力集中。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value; startups should pace themselves, start simple, and build brand as the core of every decision.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年，他强调生存是核心价值观，创业公司应循序渐进、从简单产品起步，并把品牌建设当作每个决策的核心，而非事后补充。

carlpei.en: Hardware margins are lowest; Nothing must evolve beyond hardware, focusing on applied AI, generative UI, and proactive agentic software.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他判断硬件利润率最低，Nothing 必须超越硬件，转向面向消费者的应用型 AI、生成式 UI 与主动式智能体软件。

carlpei.en: Most AI is BS; large language models are commoditizing, so AI should be an invisible ingredient solving real user pain points, not a marketing hype topic.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他直言大多数 AI 是胡扯，大语言模型正在商品化，因此 AI 应作为解决真实用户痛点的隐形配料，而非营销炒作话题。

carlpei.en: Smartphones move from app-based to intent-based interaction; agents act proactively after trust, with voice input and visual output as the most efficient interface.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，他认为智能手机将从基于应用转向基于意图的交互，智能体在建立信任后主动执行任务，最高效的界面是语音输入加视觉输出。

carlpei.en: Design and brand are the fastest differentiators in mature categories; challengers win through marketing arbitrage and organic content, not by copying giants.
carlpei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：在成熟品类中，设计与品牌是最快的差异化手段；挑战者靠营销套利和有机内容取胜，而非模仿巨头。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs into sequences point toward AGI.
nando.zh: AI 应像显微镜一样延伸人类能力；把一切输入都 token 化为序列的通用智能体，是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video like YouTube can train agents without expensive reinforcement learning; robots should learn as humans do.
nando.zh: 像 YouTube 视频这样的学习方式，能在不依赖昂贵强化学习的情况下训练智能体；机器人应像人类一样学习。

nando.en: Large models excite but are not everything; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, and diversity is essential.
nando.zh: 大模型令人兴奋但并非全部；根本性创新可以来自任何地方，多样性与包容对构建有益技术至关重要。

nando.en: The goal is AI that augments scientists and laborers, creating new symbols and knowledge like Einstein's thought experiments.
nando.zh: 目标是让 AI 增强科学家与劳动者，像爱因斯坦的思想实验那样创造新的符号与知识。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges; we don't yet have solutions.
nando.zh: AI 安全与负责任部署是当今最大的挑战；我们目前还没有解决方案。

kohli.en: AI for science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications; AlphaFold, GraphCast, GNOME and FunSearch show broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他主张科学 AI 应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用；AlphaFold、GraphCast、GNOME 与 FunSearch 展示了广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors; AI must be forced to generalize, not memorize.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他认为大语言模型的幻觉在配合真实性检测器时可被用于创造性发现；AI 必须被强制泛化，而非记忆。

kohli.en: DeepMind avoids problems solvable by top universities, focusing on those requiring scale; material science impact will take 5-10 years.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他指出 DeepMind 避开顶尖大学可解决的问题，聚焦需要 Scaling（规模扩张）的问题；材料科学的影响还需 5-10 年。

kohli.en: AlphaGo combined intuition and search; Move 37 showed AI can produce insights beyond human knowledge, a transition point in specific areas.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他回顾 AlphaGo 结合直觉与搜索；第 37 手表明 AI 能产生超越人类知识的洞见，是特定领域超越人类的转折点。

kohli.en: LLMs are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle to go beyond human data; post-training with reinforcement learning is now key, and verifiable domains like code are crucial.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他提出大语言模型是通往智能的捷径，却难以超越人类数据；后训练结合强化学习如今是关键，代码等可验证领域至关重要。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI, grounding knowledge and reducing hallucinations; LLMs are like operating systems.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径，能为知识提供基础、减少幻觉；并把 LLM 比作操作系统，语言是界面、工具是软件、向量数据库是硬盘。

jimfan.en: Reinforcement learning should be a cherry on top; unsupervised learning does most work. Simulation enables safe, parallel embodied training.
jimfan.zh: 同年他强调强化学习只应是锦上添花，无监督学习承担主要工作；仿真对具身智能体的安全、大规模并行训练至关重要。

jimfan.en: Consistent: simple, elegant, end-to-end solutions scale better than complex modular approaches; research taste is crucial.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年一以贯之：简单、优雅的端到端方案比复杂的模块化方案更具可扩展性，研究品味至关重要。

jimfan.en: Data is the bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data via simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化判断：数据是机器人领域的主要瓶颈，通过仿真和世界模型生成的合成数据是扩展机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: Physical Turing test is the grand challenge; system one remains hardest; GPT-3 moment for robotics in ~5 years, home use later.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年他提出物理图灵测试是具身 AI 的终极挑战，系统一（低层控制）仍是最难的部分；机器人领域的 GPT-3 时刻约五年后到来，家庭使用则更晚。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must feel fast, familiar, and zero-learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计师应当写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快速、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; reuse familiar patterns, and chase ROI on what to perfect.
henrymodisett.zh: 不要在交互设计上创新；复用熟悉模式，只对值得做好的部分追求投资回报率。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs: clear decisions and designer empowerment matter more than perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 不惜一切代价追求速度：清晰的决策与赋予设计师权力，比追求完美更重要。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计是战略武器；创始人必须讲清楚设计为何能帮公司取胜。

henrymodisett.en: Brand narrative is a recruiting tool; people join a brand, not a company, so invest early.
henrymodisett.zh: 品牌叙事是招聘工具；人们加入的是品牌而非公司，所以要尽早投入。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被低估：它解决“上手”问题并大幅提升智能，而随着长上下文与自适应算力带来动态专业化，微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL on language models adds a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI without new breakthroughs.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他强调语言模型上的强化学习开辟了新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，与预训练并列；预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能），无需新突破。

sholto.en: Agent reliability, measured by success rate over time horizon, is the real bottleneck—not raw capability.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他反复指出智能体的真正瓶颈是可靠性——以时间跨度上的成功率衡量——而非原始能力；智能体式连贯性延长会极大扩展可做之事。

sholto.en: Coding is the leading indicator and most tractable domain due to verifiability and replayability, accelerating AI research.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他坚持编码是 AI 进展的领先指标，也是因可验证、可重放而最可攻克的领域，并会加速 AI 研究本身。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and tools matter more now; compute is the bottleneck, and world models are not on the critical path.
sholto.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断模型已出现巨大能力过剩，编排与工具比原始智能更重要；算力成为瓶颈，而世界模型不在通往 AGI 的关键路径上，编码与 AI 研究才是直接路线。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not yield common sense; better inference algorithms and data can let smaller models outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年她质疑单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）能否解决常识问题，认为更好的推理算法与数据能让小模型在特定任务上超越大模型。

yejin.en: Pre-training via next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning; post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety.
yejin.zh: 2023 年她指出预训练的下一个词预测目标与人类学习根本错位，后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对安全与可用性至关重要。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current methods interpolate human knowledge, not transcend it. Open research is crucial.
yejin.zh: 2025 年她将数据视为根本瓶颈，认为现有方法只是对人类知识做插值而非超越，并强调开放研究对 AI 民主化的关键作用。

yejin.en: RL requires careful engineering; RLVR can hurt pass@k even as best-of-n improves, and random rewards can still help.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年她深化对强化学习的理解：RLVR 可能在 best-of-n 提升时反而降低 pass@k，随机或错误奖励有时也能改善表现，说明强化学习需要精细工程。

yejin.en: Small language models with diverse synthetic data and pluralistic alignment can rival frontier models; homogeneity is a real risk.
yejin.zh: 2026 年她主张用高质量、多样化的合成数据与多元对齐打造强大的小语言模型，指出前沿模型存在同质化风险，小模型可凭更好的数据与算法胜出。

truell.en: Scaling laws still drive predictable AI progress; test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the next driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年，他仍相信缩放定律带来可预测的进步，并预判测试时算力扩张可能超越预训练，成为下一个主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年，他认为智能体虽有前景但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心，自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式。

truell.en: The editor is becoming an AI-integrated environment; custom models are essential for speed and cost, not just frontier models.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，编辑器正演变为 AI 集成的环境；出于速度与成本，自研模型变得不可或缺，而非只依赖前沿模型。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
truell.zh: 2025 年，编程从写代码转向更高层的意图指定，人始终掌舵；品味与逻辑设计比谨慎细致更有价值。

truell.en: The AI shift is more consequential than the internet and will take decades; hiring should be slow and world-class, contrary to startup advice.
truell.zh: 2025 年，他深化判断：AI 变革比互联网更具颠覆性且需数十年；招聘应慢而精、只招世界级人才，这与常见创业建议相反。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems; AI is a creative partner to jam with openly.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈，引导工程师、对齐问题；把 AI 当作创作伙伴，开放地一起即兴协作。

nadchishtie.en: Quality behaves like debt, fluctuating and paid off iteratively alongside technical debt through rapid, scrappy experimentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量像债务一样波动，需要靠快速、粗糙的实验与短迭代周期，和技术债一起逐步偿还。

nadchishtie.en: The future of design tools is interoperable, with code as the source of truth; legacy layer-panel tools are outdated.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计工具的未来是可互操作的，代码是唯一事实来源；90 年代那种图层面板式工具已经过时。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small designer-engineer teams beat large squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端负责并用 AI 补齐短板的通才最有价值；小型设计师加工程师团队胜过 8-10 人的大跨职能小组。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in its early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成基本要求；不采用它，就像互联网早期无视互联网一样。

shazeer.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though internals remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: LLM 通过下一个词预测解决了一个 AI 完全问题；靠更多算力和数据的 Scaling（规模扩张）让 AI 更聪明，但网络内部仍是炼金术。

shazeer.en: Dialogue is the killer app; unforeseen applications emerge, and big tech's brand-risk caution slows launches.
shazeer.zh: 对话是杀手级应用；最佳应用常出乎创造者预料，而大厂因品牌风险与安全顾虑拖慢了发布。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is the near-term opportunity; models need trillion-token context windows and modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts.
shazeer.zh: 推理时算力扩展是近期机会；模型需要万亿级 token 的上下文窗口，以及混合专家等模块化稀疏架构。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not passively observing; continual learning with independently trainable modules could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察；用可独立训练的模块做持续学习，可能取代单体式重训。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute and RL drive progress but won't alone reach AGI; agentic capabilities matter, open-source closes the gap, and AGI is underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 测试时算力与强化学习推动进步，但单靠它们无法实现 AGI；智能体式能力关键，开源正缩小差距，而 AGI 被低估。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; talent gap exceeds funding gap. Focus on alignment and robustness, build skills, and don't over-worry about capability research.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他主张 AI 安全研究严重不足，人才缺口大于资金缺口，应聚焦对齐与鲁棒性，优先技能积累，不必过度担忧参与能力研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman AI; we need scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research. Evaluation is easier than generation.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超级智能，必须依靠可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究，并强调评估比生成更容易。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved, compute promises broken. Post-training alone can't align AGI; third-party testing and regulation needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化，超级对齐团队解散、算力承诺未兑现，指出仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI，呼吁第三方测试和监管。

leike.en: Empirical alignment research and measuring progress now are crucial; uncertainty about true alignment is the biggest risk, not misalignment itself.
leike.zh: 始终，他坚持对齐研究必须实证、可测量，认为最大风险不是对齐失败本身，而是无法确定系统是否真正对齐。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; current reinforcement learning lacks it, but simulation and self-play can teach complex skills like tennis.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他认为机器人需要分层推理来解决长时程信用分配问题，但当前强化学习缺乏这种能力；不过通过模拟和自对弈可以教会机器人网球等复杂技能。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning combined with reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded; 99.9% reliability is the benchmark for warehouse robots.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他提出无监督学习与强化学习结合能大幅提升样本效率；先验知识应用于数据增强而非硬编码到网络；99.9% 的可靠性是仓库机器人的价值基准。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning patterns that transfer to non-language tasks like image classification and protein binding prediction.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他指出预训练语言模型内化了通用推理模式，可迁移到图像分类和蛋白质结合预测等非语言任务。

abbeel.en: Transfer learning via fine-tuning large pre-trained models is a major success; generality of the human brain inspires AI, though current AI is far less general.
abbeel.zh: 始终，他认为通过微调大型预训练模型进行迁移学习是重大成功；人脑的通用性启发 AI 研究，但当前 AI 的通用性远不及人脑。
